Wanja Writes

Wanja Writes is the creative practice of a Kenyan poet, culture writer, communications consultant, and filmmaker. Working across words, images, and lived experiences, Wanja explores identity, memory, belonging, and the stories that shape us. Her work bridges artistic expression and cultural documentation, preserving voices and experiences that deserve to be remembered.

One-Jar Poetry

Biography

One-Jar Poetry is the artistic identity of Kenyan performance poet Faith Wanja, exploring the intersections of womanhood, identity, belonging, grief, love, social justice, and generational healing. Through spoken word, written poetry, and experiential storytelling, One-Jar Poetry creates spaces for emotional honesty, reflection, and connection. The practice embraces poetry as a means of documenting lived experiences, confronting difficult truths, and imagining possibilities for healing and becoming. From intimate reflections to socially conscious performances, One-Jar Poetry invites audiences to sit with discomfort, recognise themselves in shared stories, and discover the many ways words can hold what we carry.
